d:
796 deletion forms. 25 booths. Just 3 neighbourhoods.
In north east Delhi's Mustafabad, over 76% of all voter deletion applications during Delhi's SIR were filed against Muslim voters in Dayalpur, Nehru Vihar and Chandu Nagar - neighbourhoods with sizeable muslim population.
The Hindu went to the ground and met 87 of those voters. They were all living at their addresses. Following our first report, Election Commission itself found 36 applications to be false/fabricated, while verification of the rest is ongoing.
